clauses.anchor: Task paragraph 1: preserve "GPL attribution"

known_issues: benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-mutant-tanks-release-regressions-hard/tests/verify.py:482-505: every one of the ten server boots is all-or-nothing. "Exception reported:", an unbound native, a plugin load failure or a crash marker before FINAL, a duplicate/missing case or a FINAL mismatch fails every case of that boot, preserved guards included. The starter itself logs SourceMod exceptions (Boss array index), which is why whole boots fail there.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-mutant-tanks-release-regressions-hard/tests/verify.py:321-325 and :116-253: the public-API consumer compile and the package/GPL checks are not named cases; if they fail, verification aborts before any case is printed and all 57 cases are unobserved.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-mutant-tanks-release-regressions-hard/tests/suite.sp:1376-1413: the rainbow "old owner" checks require the exact neutral color (255,255,255) at two samples; they already pass in the starter because nothing is transferred there, so on their own they cannot distinguish "reset" from "never owned".
